# ErikrafT AI

> ErikrafT AI is an open-source web app with two image workflows: FLUX text-to-image and an experimental image + text → image flow using Qwythos interpretation followed by FLUX rendering. The website offers Portuguese (Brazil) and English interfaces, Firebase Authentication, and usage limits.

- Website: https://ai.erikraft.com/
- Source repository: https://github.com/erikraft/AI
- Privacy policy: https://ai.erikraft.com/privacy.html
- Terms of use: https://ai.erikraft.com/terms.html
- Hugging Face Space (image backend): https://huggingface.co/spaces/ErikrafT/erikraft-ai
- Text-to-image model: aoxo/flux.1dev-abliterated
- Experimental image + text → image workflow: fluffy12222/Qwythos-9B-Claude-Mythos-5-1M-heretic-abliterated interprets an uploaded reference image and instructions; FLUX renders the final pixels in a separate GPU request.
- The Qwythos model card is tagged `image-text-to-image`, but the current integration uses its multimodal output as a text prompt and does not directly render image pixels from Qwythos. End-to-end hardware/model compatibility still requires testing.
- Authentication providers: Google, GitHub, and email/password with verified email addresses.
- Availability and generation quotas depend on the site's rate limits and Hugging Face hardware/service limits.

- Legal and policy pages are general information and do not guarantee compliance with every jurisdiction or approval by any government service.

For project details, consult the README and source files in the GitHub repository.
